Question ID: SPEECH_U05_L01_GuidedPractice_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.SPEECH.COM.03

Feedback: Add a specific example for your audience. Which revision move is strongest?

answer.text: A. Ignore the feedback and keep the draft the same

feedback.text: This choice is incomplete because it does not improve the speech draft in a clear, audience-focused way.

answer.text: B. Add an example that explains the point for the audience

feedback.text: Correct. This choice improves the speech by using feedback, clarity, cohesion, or standard English to support audience understanding.

answer.text: C. Add a random fact that does not fit the point

feedback.text: This choice reflects a common misconception. Recheck the feedback or sentence connection before revising.

answer.text: D. Make the draft longer but not clearer

feedback.text: This choice weakens communication because it ignores how the audience will understand the speech.
